title: Intelligent Analysis of Real-World Tunnel Inspection Data
subtitle: Learning infrastructure condition from engineering inspection
question: How can AI extract reliable infrastructure-condition information from complex, noisy and partially occluded tunnel inspection data?
context: Mobile laser scanning, grayscale tunnel imagery, seepage inspection, structural surface defects, point clouds and tunnel geometry.
progress: The CV lists research on seepage-defect recognition from grayscale tunnel cross-section scanning images, alongside engineering experience in mobile laser scanning and structural-parameter analysis.
direction: This work represents the transition between real-world engineering monitoring and data-driven AI research.
next: Continue developing reliable condition-information extraction from complex engineering observations.
outputs: The related paper is listed in the CV. No public DOI, code or dataset link was supplied.
